answer_2.quote: We use P@20 and mean average precision (MAP) metrics computed with the official trec_eval tool to evaluate the performance of participating systems.

answer_4.quote: We here provide insights into the cases where the retrieved definitions do indeed help the underlying model in the retrieval tasks. To this end, we manually check the quality of the disambiguation of the query terms, and perform a comparison of VanillaBERT and SIR according to the MAP score per query.
answer_4.guideline: We compute the absolute difference of MAP between systems for each query in Robust04 and pick the top ones where SIR performs better than VanillaBERT and those where it performs worse.
